notes: VAT standard rate 10% (Dept. of Inland Revenue FAQs). Bullion coded 10: the complete First (zero-rated) and Second (exempt) Schedules of the VAT Act 2014 were read; a text search for gold found no matches. Silver 10/10. Duty null: the Tariff Act 2023 ch. 71 lines were readable only in a clean-text copy on a non-official host, so the (apparently Free) rates are not coded.

sources.name: Department of Inland Revenue (inlandrevenue.finance.gov.bs) - VAT FAQs
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the standard rate of VAT for most goods and services is 10%
sources.quote: The standard rate of VAT for most goods and services is 10%. Some goods and services are zero-rated, i.e. a 0% rate of VAT applies to them, and some are exempt.
